LanguageData.ABY_NullCantor.label: null cantor
LanguageData.ABY_NullCantor.description: A compact ritual focus-carbine for acolyte operators. Its barrel-ring recites a controlled breach pulse through residue-lined circuitry, turning a firing cycle into something disturbingly close to a chant. It is light enough for second-line specialists and precise enough to defend the circle, but it is not built to replace heavier abyssal war rifles.
